evidence based inputs.This elog book reflect s my patients centered online portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comments is welcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003EChief complaint \u003C\/b\u003E-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;A 54 yrs old male patient of resident suryapet, shop keeper by occupation came to opd with chief complaint of pedal edema from 1 month and fever from 4 days.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of present illness-\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparantly asymptomatic 6months months back and then he developed\u0026nbsp; fever\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;associated with chills , rigor and vomitings. He was admitted in local hospital and was found to have raised creatinine levels and diagnosed as renal failure. He was under observation for 10days and treated . He was on medication for 5months. (Tab dolo650mg, inj zofer4mg , Iv NS, sodocel 500mg)Later one month back he developed pedal edema and before4 days back he developed fever which is intermittent type no diurnal variation , not associated with cough and cold , burning micturition loose stools vomiting , associated with chills and rigors.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of past illness-\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of NSAID abuse\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/o Left Hip replacement 15yrs back\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/o discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.This elog book reflect s my patients centered online portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comments is welcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003EChief complaint\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 65year old male patient of resident\u0026nbsp; farmer by occupation came to opd with a complaint of\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECough with Expectoration and right knee pain from 1 year , lower back ache, neck pain, and burning sensation of feet from 6 months.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of present illness\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently Assymtomatic since 1year then he developed cough with Expectoration (thick, whitish, non blood tinged, odour less sputum).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo History of fever, cold, shortness of breath, chestpain.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of lower back ache radiating to lower limb since 6 months\u0026nbsp; not associated with tingling sensation.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of neck pain radiating to upper limb since 6 months not associated with tingling old male "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"A 49 YEAR OLD MALE PATIENT CAME WITH SEVERE VOMITINGS AND HIGH BLOOD SUGARS.\u003Cdiv\u003ECASE SHEET:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EChief complaints:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 47 year old male, driver by occupation, came to causality with chief complaints of:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- vomitings since 2:00 a.m.- 8-10 episodes\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;(18-07-2022)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient was apparently asymptomatic 10 years back. Then he had fever, generalised weakness for which he got checked with the local practitioner and was diagnosed with type II Diabetes Mellitus and started with OHA (oral hypoglycemic agents).\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA year later, he developed headacheheadache and was diagnosed with hypertension for which he used medication for an year and stopped them.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E6 years back, the patient developed weakness of limbs (lower limbs weakness than that of your limbs) for which he got diagnosed with low potassium levels and treatment was given conservatively.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E15 days back, the patient had symptoms of headache with blackouts. He also developed vomitings 3 to 4 episodes for which he went to a local hospital and was referred to higher centre, where he was diagnosed to have acute ischemic stroke (posterior circulation stroke).\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA day back, the patient woke up in the middle of night at 2:00 a.m. and had vomitings 8 episodes, followed by dizziness, for which he went to a local hospital and was found to have high blood sugars and was referred to our hospital.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EASSOCIATED DISEASES:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient is a known case of type II Diabetes Mellitus for 10 years.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient is a known case of acute ischemic stroke 15 days back (left postero-inferior aspect of cerebellum and left middle cerebellar peduncle).\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet: Mixed\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel: Regular\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMicturition: Normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite: Normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHabits: Regular alcohol intake and smoking\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of allergy, asthma, epilepsy, tuberculosis, coronary artery diseases.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFAMILY
